title: San Diego's North Park Tour
blurb:
The city is a canvas! Come enjoy a thriving neighborhood with beautiful street art, shops, cafes and breweries. 

North Park is known as a fun, hip, walkable neighborhood. It's very welcoming to visitors, while remaining mostly frequented by local San Diegans.

Guests are consistently impressed by how much they learn on this tour, and appreciate the wonderful photo opportunities along the way!
